Import: `import { Fab } from "@tundralibs/ui/fab"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Fab`

```ts
Fab(props: FabProps): Html
```

Floating action button: the one primary action a screen keeps within
thumb's reach — fixed to a bottom corner, above the content. Add
`attrs: { class: "fab--static" }` to show it in flow (docs, a catalogue).

## Types

### `FabPosition`

Which bottom corner (or the centre) the button sits in.

- `"end"`
- `"start"`
- `"center"`

### `FabVariant`

- `"primary"`
- `"accent"`

### `FabSize`

- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `FabProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `icon` | `Html` | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` | yes | The accessible name; shown beside the icon when `extended`. |
| `extended` | `boolean` |  | A pill with the label visible. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Makes it a link. |
| `position` | `FabPosition` |  |  |
| `variant` | `FabVariant` |  |  |
| `size` | `FabSize` |  |  |
| `hideOnScroll` | `boolean` |  | fab.js hides it while the page scrolls down and shows it on the way up. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A compose button that gets out of the way

Fixed to the bottom end; `hideOnScroll` tucks it away while the page scrolls down.

```ts
Fab({
  id: "compose",
  icon: Icon("edit", { size: 24 }),
  label: "Compose",
  href: "/mail/new",
  hideOnScroll: true,
})
```

```html
<a href="/mail/new" class="fab" id="compose" aria-label="Compose" data-fab="" data-fab-hide-on-scroll="">
  <span class="fab__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="24" height="24" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
</a>
```

### Extended, with the label showing

```ts
Fab({
  id: "new-project",
  icon: Icon("plus", { size: 20 }),
  label: "New project",
  extended: true,
  variant: "accent",
})
```

```html
<button type="button" class="fab fab--accent fab--extended" id="new-project" data-fab="">
  <span class="fab__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="20" height="20" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="fab__label">New project</span>
</button>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/fab/fab.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.fab`, `.fab--accent`, `.fab--center`, `.fab--extended`, `.fab--hidden`, `.fab--lg`, `.fab--start`, `.fab--static`, `.fab__icon`

## Behaviour

`components/fab/fab.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-fab-hide-on-scroll`.
